edition_note: Locators are Valmiki Ramayana vulgate (southern recension) as numbered on valmikiramayan.net, accessed 2026-11-17. Critical Edition numbers not checked. 'tradition' marks iconography from later painting and popular depiction, not from a verse.

rama.name: Rama
rama.age: about 25 (3.47.10b–11a, Sita's account of his age at the exile; valmikiramayan.net notes the line is missing in some older manuscripts)
rama.face: oval face, broad calm forehead, long lotus-shaped eyes with a coppery warmth, straight nose, gentle closed-mouth smile, clean-shaven
rama.skin: deep dark skin with a cool blue-lotus undertone (indīvara-śyāma, 2.2.53); recommended deliberate choice, never saturated cartoon blue
rama.build: tall, broad-shouldered, long arms (mahābāhu, 2.2.22), athletic but not bulky
rama.hair: long black hair, partly tied in a small knot at the crown, the rest falling to the shoulders
rama.attire: yellow silk dhoti (pītāmbara) with a saffron sash at the waist, a light saffron uttarīya over one shoulder, bare chest with a white sacred thread
rama.jewellery: gold earrings, a gold necklace with a single ruby pendant, gold armlets, a pearl string
rama.crown_accessories: simple gold diadem with a small central lotus (prince, before coronation); the bow only in outdoor scenes
rama.marks: the only character with the yellow-and-saffron combination; calm eyes; blue-lotus undertone
rama.motion: unhurried and still; small head turns, lowered eyes when praised, folded hands to elders; never fast, never snarky (sensitivity checklist)
rama.prompt: Prince Rama, a young Indian prince about twenty-five with deep dark skin with a cool blue-lotus undertone, an oval face with long lotus-shaped eyes and a gentle closed-mouth smile, clean-shaven, long black hair partly tied at the crown, a simple gold diadem with a small lotus, gold earrings and a gold necklace with a ruby pendant, a white sacred thread across his bare chest, a yellow silk dhoti with a saffron sash and a light saffron shawl over one shoulder, tall and broad-shouldered with exactly two arms, calm and dignified

states.exile: same face and body; bark-cloth garments (2.37) and later matted hair tied high (2.52); keep the saffron sash colour as a narrow cloth band for recognition

rama.depiction: Face shown respectfully from AK01 (owner decision 2026-11-17). Calm, never comic, never action-hero snarl. Tradition (Pahari painting, Ravi Varma prints, the 1992 Indo-Japanese film) paints him blue; the bible chooses dark with a blue undertone to follow śyāma. Test 4 seeds before AK01 images.

sita.name: Sita (Vaidehi, Janaki)
sita.age: about 18 (3.47.11a, same caveat as Rama's age)
sita.face: soft oval face, large calm eyes, gentle composed expression, a small red bindi
sita.skin: golden-wheat complexion (tradition; verse not checked in this pass)
sita.hair: long black hair in a single thick braid, a line of red sindoor in the parting (tradition)
sita.attire: ivory silk sari with a broad gold border, a lotus-pink uttarīya drawn over the shoulder and, in rites, over the head; fully draped
sita.jewellery: gold forehead ornament (maang tikka), gold earrings, a modest gold necklace, gold bangles
sita.crown_accessories: a delicate gold hair ornament; no crown
sita.motion: still and composed; hands folded at the fire; small head turn towards Rama; never posed for allure
sita.prompt: Sita, a young Indian princess about eighteen with a golden-wheat complexion, a soft oval face with large calm eyes and a small red bindi, long black hair in a single thick braid with a line of red sindoor in the parting, a gold forehead ornament, gold earrings and gold bangles, an ivory silk sari with a broad gold border and a lotus-pink shawl drawn over her shoulder, fully and modestly draped, graceful and upright with exactly two arms, composed and dignified

states.exile: bark-cloth over the sari (2.37); jewellery reduced but the gold forehead ornament stays as her recognition mark

sita.depiction: Never sexualised (sensitivity checklist). Strong presence: in Ayodhya Kanda she insists on going to the forest (2.26–2.30), so posture is upright, not meek.

lakshmana.name: Lakshmana

lakshmana.jewellery: gold earrings, a simple gold necklace, gold armlets

bharata.name: Bharata

rules: Prefix every keyframe prompt with style_prefix; reuse character prompts verbatim through {id} tokens.
Positive phrasing only: Z-Image Turbo runs at guidance 0 and ignores negative prompts.
At most 2 characters in a close or medium shot; crowds only distant, small and well separated.
One clear action per shot for image-to-video; no interlocked hands or arms.
Faces calm, mouths closed (narration is voice-over).
Costume and architecture ancient Indian (Ajanta murals, Gupta sculpture): dhoti, uttarīya, mukuṭa; carved sandstone, shikhara towers. Palette from Pahari painting only.
Deities symbolic (radiant light), as in the Bala Kanda rules.
Gold accent #E8BE6E visible in every frame.
Screen direction: Rama's party left to right; threats right to left.
Title headroom top 12%, captions lower 25%, no borders, no text in images.
